Back after upload takes you to wrong screen plus caching issues

I was creating a new map, i searched for the unit, selected it, uploaded the document, hit map, and then hit back (in mapper not the browser) and i was expecting to go back to the upload screen as i wanted to see the estimated credit usage, instead it took me back to the search screen, i then had to research for the unit i wanted, reselect it and then when i got back to the upload screen, the document was still there.

Fix the back button so it takes me back to the upload screen with my document if possible.

Also - if i go back and then instead select another unit the document is still there. In this case i think it should be gone.

Also - if i select a certificate and select multiple units, it adds the document to all units tabs in the upload screen.
